newsitem.title: UK: NatWest appoints senior global sales head.
newsitem.headline: NatWest appoints senior global sales head.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of Britain's National Westminster Bank Plc, on Friday announced a key sales appointment in its financial markets arm.
NatWest said in a statement Peter Nielsen would become global head of sales in its global financial markets division with immediate effect.
Nielsen, who will be based in London, will also be a member of the 10-strong global financial markets executive committee.
He joined NatWest in 1995 and for the last two years has overseen foreign exchange and money market sales and trading in NatWest Markets' Treasury division in New York.
